clawpilot_email_bindings.create:
CREATE TABLE `clawpilot_email_bindings` (
  `pipeline_id` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `workspace_id` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `group_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `generation` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `owner_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `readers_json` text NOT NULL,
  `audience_fingerprint` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `policy_fingerprint` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `runtime_fingerprint` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `capability_policy_json` mediumtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `capability_policy_fingerprint` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `enabled` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`pipeline_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `group_id` (`group_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3 COLLATE=utf8mb3_general_ci

clawpilot_email_identities.create:
CREATE TABLE `clawpilot_email_identities` (
  `email_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `global_id` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `local_id` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `pipeline_id` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `workspace_id` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `app_archived` tinyint(4) NOT NULL,
  `capabilities_json` mediumtext DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`email_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `global_id` (`global_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `local_id` (`local_id`),
  KEY `cp_email_pipeline` (`pipeline_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3 COLLATE=utf8mb3_general_ci

clawpilot_email_operations.create:
CREATE TABLE `clawpilot_email_operations` (
  `operation_id` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `command_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `pipeline_id` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `email_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `state` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `result_json` mediumtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`operation_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `CONSTRAINT_1` CHECK (`state` in ('committed','cancelled'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3 COLLATE=utf8mb3_general_ci

clawpilot_email_authority_approvals.create:
CREATE TABLE `clawpilot_email_authority_approvals` (
  `operation_id` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `transition_id` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `command_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `desired_app_change_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `phase` varchar(8) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `service_user_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `oauth_client_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `app_commit_fingerprint` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `proof_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `proof_json` text NOT NULL,
  `proof_signature` varchar(512) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `revoked` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`operation_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `CONSTRAINT_1` CHECK (`phase` in ('revoke','grant')),
  CONSTRAINT `CONSTRAINT_2` CHECK (`phase` <> 'grant' or `app_commit_fingerprint` is not null)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3 COLLATE=utf8mb3_general_ci

clawpilot_email_authority_operations.create:
CREATE TABLE `clawpilot_email_authority_operations` (
  `operation_id` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `transition_id` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `command_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `phase` varchar(8) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `state` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `result_json` mediumtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`operation_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `CONSTRAINT_1` CHECK (`phase` in ('revoke','grant')),
  CONSTRAINT `CONSTRAINT_2` CHECK (`state` in ('committed','cancelled')),
  CONSTRAINT `CONSTRAINT_3` CHECK (`state` = 'committed' = (`result_json` is not null))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3 COLLATE=utf8mb3_general_ci

clawpilot_email_write_permissions.create:
CREATE TABLE `clawpilot_email_write_permissions` (
  `email_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `pipeline_id` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `capabilities_json` mediumtext NOT NULL,
  `source_kind` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,

) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3 COLLATE=utf8mb3_general_ci
